name: ekka/alpaca-data
title: Alpaca market data: read daily price bars, nothing else
credential_format: Your Alpaca PAPER key id and secret key joined with a colon, KEYID:SECRET, the same pair the paper server takes. open.sh joins them for you at a hidden prompt. This row reads prices only; it has no call that can place, change or cancel anything.

operations.title: Read daily price bars for a list of symbols, adjusted for splits and dividends

start.description: The first day to return, YYYY-MM-DD. The kit asks for about three weeks so five trading days are always inside it.
